desc:
【New Update 10/23】
⛏️Added 5 new pickaxes including the BeamMiner, which fires a beam to mine blocks.
💎Introduced jump scare elements—watch out when opening doors!
🚀Earn passive rewards based on your offline time, claimable in the lobby.

Check the in-game update log for more details.

-Story
The tragedy began here. On a remote island, sinners are forced to mine for the Shogun. But deep in the dark, some things should never be unearthed. You have entered the domain of PETAPETA.

-Gameplay
・Explore the Mine : Wander through twisting tunnels and use your pickaxe to collect ores, gems, and other valuable finds.
・The Minecart : Bring your discoveries back to the minecart, unlock the next floor, and venture deeper into the mine.
・Hide to Survive : If PETAPETA sees you, use narrow paths and helpful items to escape and stay out of its sight.

How far can you descend into the abyss before the curse takes you...?
